CreatePage.title: LinkLockr - Secure Paid Links with Smart Contracts
CreatePage.description: Sell access to your digital content
CreatePage.description_unused: Create and share paid links securely using blockchain technology. LinkLockr enables content creators to monetize their links with ease and security.
CreatePage.modalDescription: LinkLockr encrypts your text, stores it on IPFS, then unencrypts and delivers it upon payment. No traditional financial intermediaries, just you and your audience.
CreatePage.step1_desc: Enter the URL or text you want to sell.
CreatePage.step2_desc: Displayed in US Dollars, paid in USDC on the Base chain.
CreatePage.step3_desc: Enter a custom purchase link or use an auto-generated one.
CreatePage.step4_desc: Payments are instantly sent to your connected wallet on the Base chain. Platform/network fees (~{percent}%) apply.
CreatePage.linkCreated_desc: Your content is encrypted on IPFS and the slug is registered on Base.
CreatePage.linkCreated_desc_unused: Your paid link is ready. Share it with your audience to start earning!

CreatePage.termsAgree: By creating this link, you agree that you have the right to sell this content and indemnify LinkLockr from any liability. Content subject to reports or copyright claims may be removed.
CreatePage.heroSubtitle: Sell access to content with instant settlement in USDC on the Base network. No chargebacks. Gas fees less than one penny. Decentralized encryption on Lit Protocol TEEs.
CreatePage.finePrintFee: Platform & network fee: ~{percent}% upon successful buyer unlock.
CreatePage.howStep1Desc: Paste any secret text or URL. Your payload is encrypted client-side and secured via Lit Protocol TEEs.
CreatePage.howStep2Desc: Choose your price in USDC and pick a memorable link slug on Base L2.
CreatePage.howStep3Desc: Post your link on Warpcast, X, Telegram, Discord, or embed it on your own blog.
CreatePage.howStep4Desc: Buyers unlock your content with USDC. Funds settle straight into your wallet with zero chargeback risk.
CreatePage.useCase1Desc: Token-gate trade setups, newsletters, and exclusive market intelligence directly to your readers.
CreatePage.useCase2Desc: Gate private Telegram channels, custom video sets, and digital drops with 0% chargebacks and instant USDC settlement.
CreatePage.useCase3Desc: Sell software scripts, AI prompts, Notion templates, and raw secret payloads with instant delivery.
